column5: Filter indicator displays when a Payer Category filter is applied
column6:
1. Navigate to https://revflow-dev.axgsolutions.com/ and log in via Microsoft SSO.
2. Land on the Supervisor Dashboard with the Highest Balances widget visible.
3. No Payer Category filter currently applied.
column8:
1. Verify the Dashboard page has finished loading.
2. Verify the Payer Category filter control is visible in the Dashboard header.
3. Click the Payer Category filter control to open it.
4. Search for Medicaid in the filter search box.
5. Select the Medicaid option from the results.
6. Click the Apply button on the filter panel.
7. Verify the Highest Balances widget is visible.
8. Verify the filter indicator/icon is visible on the Highest Balances widget.
column9:
1. Dashboard has finished loading (loading spinner absent).
2. Payer Category filter control is visible and clickable.
3. Filter panel/dropdown opens.
4. Search box shows Medicaid as typed and the option is present in the filtered list.
5. Medicaid option is shown as selected (checked).
6. Filter panel closes and the Dashboard refreshes data for Medicaid.
7. Highest Balances widget is rendered on the Dashboard.
8. Filter icon/indicator is visible on the Highest Balances widget header.

column5: Filter indicator does not display when no Payer Category filter is applied
column6:
1. Navigate to the Dashboard.
2. Ensure any previously applied Payer Category filter is reset/cleared.
column8:
1. Verify the Dashboard page has finished loading.
2. Reset the Payer Category filter (clear any prior selection).
3. Verify the Highest Balances widget is visible.
4. Verify the filter indicator/icon is NOT visible on the Highest Balances widget.
column9:
1. Dashboard has finished loading.
2. No Payer Category is selected; filter is cleared.
3. Highest Balances widget is rendered on the Dashboard.
4. Filter icon/indicator is absent from the Highest Balances widget header.

column5: Tooltip displays applied Payer Category on hover of the filter indicator
column6:
1. Navigate to the Dashboard.
2. Reset any previously applied Payer Category filter.
column8:
1. Open the Payer Category filter control.
2. Search for and select Medicaid.
3. Click Apply.
4. Verify the Highest Balances widget filter indicator is displayed.
5. Hover the mouse pointer over the filter indicator.
6. Verify a tooltip appears.
7. Read the tooltip text.
column9:
1. Filter panel opens.
2. Medicaid is selected in the filter.
3. Filter is applied and panel closes.
4. Filter indicator icon is visible on the widget.
5. Pointer is positioned over the indicator element.
6. Tooltip element becomes visible.
7. Tooltip text reads 'Payer Category Filters (Medicaid)'.

column5: Tooltip reflects multiple selected Payer Categories
column6:
1. Navigate to the Dashboard.
2. Reset any previously applied Payer Category filter.
column7: Two distinct Payer Category options selected at random from the dropdown
column8:
1. Open the Payer Category filter control.
2. Select two distinct Payer Category options.
3. Click Apply.
4. Hover over the Highest Balances widget filter indicator.
5. Verify the tooltip is visible.
6. Read the tooltip text and check it references both selected categories.
column9:
1. Filter panel opens.
2. Both options show as selected (checked).
3. Filter is applied; both categories are now active.
4. Pointer is positioned over the indicator element.
5. Tooltip element becomes visible.
6. Tooltip text contains the names of both selected Payer Categories.

column5: Filter indicator and tooltip update when the Payer Category filter is changed
column6:
1. Navigate to the Dashboard.
2. Reset any previously applied Payer Category filter.
column7: Initial: Medicaid; Changed to: any other available Payer Category
column8:
1. Apply the Payer Category filter with Medicaid selected.
2. Hover the filter indicator and confirm the tooltip shows Medicaid.
3. Re-open the filter, deselect Medicaid, and select a different Payer Category.
4. Click Apply.
5. Verify the filter indicator is still displayed.
6. Hover the filter indicator again and read the tooltip.
column9:
1. Medicaid filter is applied; indicator appears.
2. Tooltip text contains Medicaid.
3. Filter panel shows the new category selected and Medicaid deselected.
4. Filter is re-applied with the new category active.
5. Filter indicator remains visible on the Highest Balances widget.
6. Tooltip text contains the newly applied category and no longer contains Medicaid.

column5: Filter indicator and tooltip are cleared when the Payer Category filter is removed
column6:
1. Navigate to the Dashboard.
2. Reset any previously applied Payer Category filter.
column8:
1. Apply the Payer Category filter with Medicaid selected.
2. Verify the filter indicator is displayed.
3. Remove/reset the applied Payer Category filter.
4. Verify the filter indicator is no longer displayed.
5. Hover over where the indicator was on the Highest Balances widget.
6. Verify no tooltip is displayed.
column9:
1. Medicaid filter is applied; indicator appears.
2. Filter indicator icon is visible.
3. Filter is cleared/reset; no Payer Category remains selected.
4. Filter indicator icon is no longer visible on the widget.
5. Pointer hovers over the widget area.
6. No filter tooltip is rendered.
